method_card.title: Sine Rule, Cosine Rule & Area Formula
method_card.content:
Sine rule: \(\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B}\), for a side or angle with a matching pair.

Cosine rule (side): \(a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A\); (angle): \(\cos A = \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc}\).

Area: \(\frac12 ab\sin C\).

steps: Ambiguous case: after an acute angle from the sine rule, test 180 minus it and reject any that overshoot 180.
Area rearranged for an angle: sin C = 2 × Area ÷ (ab). Heron's formula gives area straight from three sides.
Parallelogram from two triangles: area = \(ab\sin\theta\), with no half.
